# Ad Auction Lab

> Position auctions, bid shading, budget pacing, hashed CTR models and off-policy evaluation, measured on Criteo and the Open Bandit Dataset.

Languages: Python, Rust. License: MIT. Source: https://github.com/adeoluo/ad-auction-lab

## Source

- [rust/src/fm.rs](https://github.com/adeoluo/ad-auction-lab/blob/main/rust/src/fm.rs): Second-order factorization machine (Rendle, 2010) on hashed binary features, trained with AdaGrad on the log loss.
- [rust/src/ftrl.rs](https://github.com/adeoluo/ad-auction-lab/blob/main/rust/src/ftrl.rs): Logistic regression on hashed features trained with FTRL-Proximal (McMahan et al., 2013).
- [rust/src/hashing.rs](https://github.com/adeoluo/ad-auction-lab/blob/main/rust/src/hashing.rs): Feature hashing shared by every model.
- [rust/src/lib.rs](https://github.com/adeoluo/ad-auction-lab/blob/main/rust/src/lib.rs): Rust core of ad-auction-lab.
- [rust/src/metrics.rs](https://github.com/adeoluo/ad-auction-lab/blob/main/rust/src/metrics.rs): Small numeric helpers shared by the learners.
- [rust/src/pacing.rs](https://github.com/adeoluo/ad-auction-lab/blob/main/rust/src/pacing.rs): Multi-advertiser budget pacing simulator: repeated single-slot second-price auctions on expected cost per impression (eCPM = bid per click x predicted CTR).
- [rust/src/python.rs](https://github.com/adeoluo/ad-auction-lab/blob/main/rust/src/python.rs): PyO3 bindings, built by maturin into the `ad_auction_lab_rs` extension module.
- [src/ad_auction_lab/__init__.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/ad-auction-lab/blob/main/src/ad_auction_lab/__init__.py): Ad auctions, bidding, budget pacing, hashed CTR models and off-policy evaluation.
- [src/ad_auction_lab/auctions.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/ad-auction-lab/blob/main/src/ad_auction_lab/auctions.py): Position auctions for sponsored search and display slots: GSP, VCG and first price.
- [src/ad_auction_lab/backend.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/ad-auction-lab/blob/main/src/ad_auction_lab/backend.py): The Rust backend, compiled into the package on install and used by default.
- [src/ad_auction_lab/bidding.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/ad-auction-lab/blob/main/src/ad_auction_lab/bidding.py): Bid shading for first-price auctions.
- [src/ad_auction_lab/calibration.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/ad-auction-lab/blob/main/src/ad_auction_lab/calibration.py): Post-hoc calibration of click probabilities: Platt scaling and isotonic regression.
- [src/ad_auction_lab/cli.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/ad-auction-lab/blob/main/src/ad_auction_lab/cli.py): Command line interface: ``python -m ad_auction_lab <command>``.
- [src/ad_auction_lab/ctr.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/ad-auction-lab/blob/main/src/ad_auction_lab/ctr.py): Hashed click-through-rate models: FTRL-Proximal logistic regression and a factorization machine.
- [src/ad_auction_lab/ctr_reference.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/ad-auction-lab/blob/main/src/ad_auction_lab/ctr_reference.py): Readable numpy reference implementations of the hashed CTR learners.
- [src/ad_auction_lab/data.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/ad-auction-lab/blob/main/src/ad_auction_lab/data.py): Tabular click data as two categorical blocks, and the Criteo loaders.
- [src/ad_auction_lab/hashing.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/ad-auction-lab/blob/main/src/ad_auction_lab/hashing.py): Feature hashing shared with the Rust core.
- [src/ad_auction_lab/metrics.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/ad-auction-lab/blob/main/src/ad_auction_lab/metrics.py): Click model metrics: log loss, ROC AUC, normalized entropy, calibration and significance tests.
- [src/ad_auction_lab/obd.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/ad-auction-lab/blob/main/src/ad_auction_lab/obd.py): The Open Bandit Dataset (Saito et al., 2021) as bandit logs, and its contextual reward model.
- [src/ad_auction_lab/ope.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/ad-auction-lab/blob/main/src/ad_auction_lab/ope.py): Off-policy estimators for (item, position) bandit logs: IPS, SNIPS, DM, DR, SNDR, Switch-DR.
- [src/ad_auction_lab/pacing.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/ad-auction-lab/blob/main/src/ad_auction_lab/pacing.py): Budget pacing in a repeated multi-advertiser second-price auction market.
- [src/ad_auction_lab/service.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/ad-auction-lab/blob/main/src/ad_auction_lab/service.py): A standard-library HTTP service for auctions, bid shading, CTR prediction and OPE.
